about.title: Built to simplify shift-based service operations
about.hero: ControlOps gives service businesses <hl>one place</hl> to manage the people, locations, rotas, records, rates and financial processes behind shift-based work.
about.hero2: The platform is adaptable across service industries while providing <hl>specialist workflows for security companies</hl>.
about.whoText: ControlOps is developed to help operational teams replace <hl>disconnected spreadsheets</hl> and repetitive administration with one clearer source of operational information.
about.missionText: Our mission is to make capable <hl>workforce operations software</hl> accessible to growing service businesses without forcing them to adopt expensive or difficult enterprise systems.
about.audienceTitle: Designed for businesses where every shift matters
about.audienceText: ControlOps is designed for <hl>security, cleaning, facilities management, event staffing, temporary staffing</hl> and other multi-site service businesses that coordinate people across shifts and client locations.
about.securityText: Security remains a core ControlOps specialism. Security companies can manage <hl>guards, SIA licence information, right-to-work records, subcontractors</hl>, client sites, assignments, rates, payroll information and invoicing from the same platform.

home.securityHeroTitle: Command your guards, sites and shifts.
home.securityHeroText: ControlOps is the operations platform for security companies — SIA-ready guard records, multi-site coverage, live rotas, barcode patrol, incidents, payroll and client billing in one system.
home.globeText: Guards, sites and patrol checkpoints connected across every location you protect. Drag the globe to explore — ControlOps keeps vision on every shift.
home.spotlightTitle: Built for how security companies actually run
home.spotlightIntro: Every module is designed around guards on sites, shift coverage, compliance and proof of presence — not generic HR software.
home.timelineTitle: Every module your control room needs
home.timelineIntro: The core ControlOps modules for security operations — staff, sites, permissions, rotas, patrol and billing.

timelineModules.title: Staff & guards
timelineModules.description: Guard and staff profiles, photos, area filters and workforce records — the people who cover every site.

timelineModules.title: Sites
timelineModules.description: Client locations with contacts and default rates. Know who is covering which site on every shift.

timelineModules.title: Roles & permissions
timelineModules.description: Fine-grained RBAC across modules — view, create, edit and delete rights per role.

timelineModules.title: Rotas & shifts
timelineModules.description: Table and timeline planners, publish/unpublish, hours and payable totals — schedule day and night cover with confidence.

timelineModules.title: Patrol & barcode scanning

timelineModules.title: Payroll & invoicing
timelineModules.description: Turn published rota shifts into payroll-ready hours and client invoices — same shift data, no spreadsheet rework.

faqs.q: Is ControlOps only for security companies?
faqs.a: No. ControlOps is designed for <hl>shift-based service businesses</hl> that manage employees, contractors, locations or client assignments. It includes specialist workflows for security operations, but its core workforce, rota, payroll-preparation and billing features can support other service businesses.

faqs.q: What types of businesses can use ControlOps?
faqs.a: ControlOps is especially relevant to <hl>security, cleaning, facilities management, event staffing and temporary staffing</hl> businesses. Other sectors should book a demonstration so we can confirm the product fits their workflow.

faqs.q: Can we use ControlOps mainly for rota management?
faqs.a: Your available features depend on your plan. You can begin with the <hl>operational areas your team needs</hl> and introduce additional workflows as requirements develop.

Yes. Security operations can record <hl>guard and subcontractor details, SIA licence information, right-to-work records</hl>, document expiry dates, client sites, assignments, rates, payroll information and invoices. ControlOps supports internal processes but does not replace legal or regulatory responsibilities.

faqs.q: Can we move information from spreadsheets?
faqs.a: Import options depend on the format and the import features currently available. <hl>Contact us</hl> so we can review your workforce, location, rate and document data.

faqs.q: Can we see the platform before subscribing?
faqs.a: Yes. <hl>Book a demonstration</hl> to see the most relevant ControlOps workflows for your business.
